title: Other New York musicians: Gussack, the Russons and Freddie Goodman
summary: Allen runs through names; Duerr recalls a drummer Gussack, Babe Russon at White Plains and a trumpeter Freddie.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you know a guy named Ben Gussick or Cusick or something?
Yeah, a drummer?
No, no, a trumpet player.

Wait, there was a, I thought it was Ben Gussick, he played the drum, but I lost track of him, but he was a, he played, I imagine he got to work with some pretty good band around New York after I left, but he was up and coming, I know that. He never heard of him much by name, but he probably worked some pretty good, but I'm on the station. I bet he got to be a house man somewhere or something. He was in with the clique, I know that. His name was Gussack.
Gussack, huh?
Gussack, yes. See, I thought it was Ben too, he said Ben, but he might have been something else.
Gussack, yes. Did you know Jack Maysell played drums? Maysell. Maysell? Maysell? I can't place it, Bill.
I don't know.
And Max Cominsky you said you knew, didn't he?

Well, yeah, he used to come up to White Plains. And sometimes he'd come up. Did you record? And some other boys came up to, I can't remember, oh, the tenor man, Babe Russon used to come up. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Babe Russon used to come up.
And there was Ham Russon too.
Babe, and then his brother played piano, Jacky Russon played piano.

Yeah. Well Ham Russon was no piano, he was a tenor player too. Spelled his name a different way and he used to work with Hackett I just wanted to know. Oh yeah. What about Freddie Goodman, did you know him? Freddie, no I didn't know him.
The trumpet player? The trumpet player. Was Freddie played the trumpet or who was he playing the bass?
Irving.
Irving played the bass.
No. Freddie played trumpet. Freddie played trumpet, yeah.
Was he a blonde headed? Oh I didn't know him, I just heard of him, I read about him. How many brothers was that, I'm trying to think. At least three.
Yeah. Well it must have been Freddie then, I was trying to think of his first name.

It wasn't a bass player, it must have been Freddie that had just come up to the new, when I lived with Sharky, he used to get the trumpet all the time, yeah. Freddie must have been that. Yeah. And Johnny Russell, he played tenor, did you know him? Johnny Russell. Yeah. Yeah. And Johnny Russell, he played tenor, did you know him? Johnny Russell. Yeah. Yeah.
